t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Fnanglut go O Duwata na ge i ftabo deg na mimo deg agmade ge na mangamfo de ge. Gade go de kagkahon ani de klande gnagan go, dee de akgaganam de-kablasok go na dee de kalgadom. Lande dame Duwata ko la loghe de lande sen kafyem na tabongam di kat sato de gami.
